bullets.text: A road safety awareness programme was conducted for students of classes VI to VIII at Government Model High School in Tirur, and the district team should monitor ongoing student safety initiatives.
CtrlS and Ciena are partnering to build 100 Tb/s data centre metro networks across five Indian cities including Chennai, and the portfolio team should track infrastructure progress in Tamil Nadu.

Cognizant reported that artificial intelligence speeds up vulnerability discovery while enterprises struggle to fix risks, and the portfolio team should watch enterprise cybersecurity readiness in the state.
